headlines.description: — Sam Bennett and Sam Reinhart scored extra-attacker goals in the final minutes to lead a furious comeback, Evan Rodrigues got the winning goal in the shootout and the Florida Panthers stunned the Carolina Hurricanes with a 4-3 victory on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers, down 3-0 in the third, stun Hurricanes and win in shootout, 4-3

events.name: Vancouver Canucks at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Kiefer Sherwood had three goals for his second hat trick of the season as the Vancouver Canucks beat the New York Islanders 4-1 on Friday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kiefer Sherwood has hat trick as Canucks beat Islanders 4-1 for 3rd straight win

headlines.description: — Brent Burns and Martin Necas scored early and the Colorado Avalanche held on to beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-2 on Friday night for their fourth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burns, Necas give Avalanche early lead in 3-2 win over Jets for 12th straight home win

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Stefan Noesen and Connor Brown each scored goals, Nico Hischier had two assists and the New Jersey Devils beat the Utah Mammoth 2-1 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Noesen and Brown score goals as Devils beat Mammoth 2-1 for 3rd win in 4 games

headlines.description: — Jason Robertson had two goals and an assist, and the Dallas Stars beat the Anaheim Ducks 8-3 on Friday night for their third straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Robertson has 2 goals and assist as Stars beat Ducks 8-3 for 3rd straight win
